name: save-boot-11d-battle-command-rows
description: #171 (follow-up to #110 attempt 2): one metric per check, and the slot read 30 frames after the menu opens. From "stats-battle" (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; a random battle in md1_1): wait until the widget id reads 1 (open_wait), 30 frames; the slot reads 2 (slot2, within 1 frame), slot 2's row reads 0 (r2_zero, within 1 frame), Down every 20 frames (held 4) until it reads 1 (r2_down), Up every 20 frames until it reads 0 (r2_up). Take Attack on the default target as save-boot-11c does (Circle until widget 0, 20 frames, Circle until 0xffff), wait until the widget reads 1 again (next_wait), 30 frames; the slot reads 1 (slot1), slot 1's row reads 0 (no metric), Down every 20 frames until it reads 1 (r1_down), 10 frames. A wait metric is the frames waited, 0 on a timeout, which stops the script: the first 0 names the failing step. End: still battle, slot 1's row still 1, and a rerun from the same snapshot matches (no metric; determinism is also checked by two Tier 2 runs).
